description: Resource Type definition for AWS::GuardDuty::CustomDetectionRuleAssociation. Associates a GuardDuty custom detection rule with the caller's account, enabling the rule in either LIVE or DRY_RUN mode.

RuleId.description: The catalog identifier of the custom detection rule to associate.
RuleId.markdownDescription:
The catalog identifier of the custom detection rule to associate.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 100  
Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$  
Update requires: Replacement

Mode.description: Whether the rule runs in LIVE mode (generates findings) or DRY_RUN mode (evaluates without generating findings).
Mode.markdownDescription:
Whether the rule runs in LIVE mode (generates findings) or DRY_RUN mode (evaluates without generating findings).

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: LIVE | DRY_RUN  
Update requires: No interruption
